operations.name: ai.generate
operations.description: Generate image(s) from a text prompt via the server-AI gateway; each result is added as a new layer (undoable). Requires a signed-in session — server AI is the only login-gated feature. Pass 2–4 model ids for compare mode (one image per model); with 0–1 models, count (1–4) images are generated.

models.description: Model ids (max 4). Empty = gateway default model. More than one = compare mode.

count.description: Images to generate in single-model mode, 1–4 (default 1)

referenceImages.description: Hosted reference image URLs for img2img-capable models.

negativePrompt.description: Things to avoid in the output (max 1000 chars). Sent natively where the model supports it; folded into the prompt for prompt-emulating models.

seed.description: Deterministic sampling seed, integer 0–2147483647. Omit for provider-random.

steps.description: Diffusion steps, integer 1–150 (models that support it).

guidance.description: Guidance / CFG scale, 0–30 (models that support it).

strength.description: img2img init-image influence, 0–1 (models that support it; needs referenceImages).

operations.name: ai.remove_background
operations.description: Remove the background from the active raster layer through the credit-metered server matte. Multiplies existing per-pixel alpha and records one undoable AI Remove Background command in the originating document. Switching documents during the run is fine: the result still applies to the captured document (result.background=true, result.docName names it, a toast offers to jump there) — only deleting the layer, changing its pixels, or closing the document voids it. A dropped connection mid-request persists the pending job and recovers the finished (already-paid-for) result by polling instead of failing; a reload before that finishes offers to apply it on next boot (once the start screen closes) if the source layer is unchanged.

operations.name: ai.split_layers
operations.description: Decompose the active raster layer into multiple RGBA layers (Qwen-Image-Layered via the credit-metered gateway; deterministic banded mock offline). Inserts an AI Layer Split group above the source that reproduces its composite (carries blend mode, opacity×fill, and bakes any layer mask), hides the source, one undoable command. Needs at least 64×64 px of content; refuses layers inside or at the base of a clipping mask. Unavailable (clear error, menu entry disabled) when the gateway reports only the offline mock provider in a credits-enforced deployment — mock output never charges credits. Switching documents during the 60-100s run is fine: the result still applies to the captured document (result.background=true, result.docName names it, a toast offers to jump there) — only deleting the layer, changing its pixels, or closing the document voids it. A reload during the run persists the pending job; on next boot a recovery toast (shown once the start screen closes) offers to apply the finished result if the source layer is unchanged. Params: layers (2-10, default 4).
